guide_subtitle: Application usage, inner mechanics, and developer roadmap
guide_user_quickstart_desc:
Follow these basic steps to get started with Stokendra:
1. Stock Cards: Define the products in your inventory (e.g. A4 Paper, Ethernet Cable).
2. Stock Movements: Create a [Giriş/Entry] or [Çıkış/Exit] record via the 'Add New Movement' button to update active stock quantities.
3. Service Records: Keep track of devices that are faulty or routed to technical maintenance.
4. Reports & Graphs: Monitor frequently used products and below-minimum warnings via ScottPlot-powered dynamic graphs on the Dashboard.
5. Security & Settings: The system takes daily backups automatically. You can also export the database file or SQL scripts anytime.
guide_user_stockcards_desc:
Structure your inventory hierarchically using parent-child relationships:
• Parent Card: Serves only for category and grouping purposes. It holds no stock quantity and you cannot add movements to it. E.g., 'Computer Parts' is a Parent Card.
• Child Card: The actual physical inventory items that hold quantities and accept Entry/Exit movements. You can link a Child Card to any Parent Card using the selector.
• Minimum Stock: Represents the critical stock limit. When quantities drop below this value, cards are highlighted in red on the dashboard and listed in warnings.
• Units: Measure your items using different units like pieces (Adet), meters, boxes, or packs.
guide_user_movements_title: Stock Entry & Exit Operations & Bulk Excel Uploads
guide_user_movements_desc:
Stock movements are the only way to dynamically update inventory quantities:
• Stock Entry (Entry): Used to add purchased, transfer-received, or count-surplus items to the inventory.
• Stock Exit (Exit): Records items issued to departments or staff, or decremented for sale/usage. You can log recipient details and department names.
• Bulk Excel Import: To upload hundreds of cards in seconds, click the 'Download Excel Template' button, fill the sheet, and import it via 'Import from Excel' without errors.
guide_user_services_title: Technical Service Logs & Device Status Tracking
guide_user_services_desc:
Simplifies tracking of faulty or repair-routed devices:
• Logging Services: Specify the department, brand, model, fault details, and initial status of the hardware.
• Process Monitoring: Track current status values (e.g. 'Pending', 'In Progress', 'Completed', or 'Cancelled/Returned') to keep service operations under control. Add final description notes on completion.
guide_user_backup_desc:
High-level data security mechanisms are built-in to prevent database loss:
1. Automatic Daily Backups: On its first launch of the day, the program makes a copy of the database (.db) and saves it to the backup folder with a timestamp.
2. Manual Backups: Click 'Backup Database' in the Settings tab to copy your active SQLite database file to any folder.
3. SQL Schema Export: Convert your tables and data into standard SQL insert statements (.sql), making it easy to migrate your data to other database engines (PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.) in the future.
guide_user_reports_title: Dashboard Analytics, Charts, and Report Exports
guide_user_reports_desc:
Turn raw data into meaningful business intelligence:
• Dashboard Graphs: Visualize top-moving items, department usage shares, and minimum stock alerts via interactive ScottPlot charts.
• Excel & Print Exports: Export lists from Stock Cards, Movements, and Service tabs by clicking 'Export to Excel'. Use the printer icon to print directly or save as PDF.
guide_dev_perf_title: SQLite Performance, High Speed & Tuning Engine
guide_dev_perf_desc:
To ensure sub-millisecond query responses even with thousands of records, the database is tuned with these settings:
• Memory-Mapped I/O (mmap_size = 256MB): Maps database file reads directly into virtual memory, avoiding physical disk latency and speeding up reads on SSD/HDD.
• Large Memory Cache (cache_size = 128MB): Keeps active database pages in memory to reduce disk G/C.
• WAL Mode (Write-Ahead Logging): Prevents write operations from blocking reads, ensuring parallel responsiveness.
• journal_size_limit (64MB) & Incremental Auto-Vacuum: Keeps WAL files compact and prevents database bloat.
guide_dev_mvvm_desc:
The project structure strictly adheres to clean MVVM (Model-View-ViewModel) guidelines:
• ViewModels: Leverage the CommunityToolkit.Mvvm library. Boilerplate logic for `[ObservableProperty]` and `[RelayCommand]` is automatically handled by C# Source Generators at compile time.
• Dependency Injection: Built on top of Microsoft DI Container. Shared services like `IStockCardRepository`, `IMovementRepository`, and `IDialogService` along with ViewModels are registered and resolved using constructor injection.
guide_dev_folders_desc:
• Views: Avalonia UI XAML layouts (.axaml) and views code-behind.
• ViewModels: Houses application flow control, data-binding parameters, and commands (ICommand).
• Models: Represents database tables and supports property change notifications (INotifyPropertyChanged).
• Data: Coordinates SQLite connection factories, repository implementations, and incremental migrations (`Database.Migrations.cs`).
• Services: ClosedXML-backed spreadsheet imports/exports and ZipArchive backups.
• Infrastructure: Localization manager and custom XAML markup extensions.
guide_dev_lang_desc:
The multi-language system runs on dynamic JSON localization resources:
• Resource Files: Translations are saved as key-value pairs in `Resources/lang_tr.json` and `lang_en.json`.
• XAML Integration: Custom markup extension `{infra:L key}` binds translations dynamically in views.
• Live Refresh: Changing language preferences instantly reloads resources through `LocalizationManager` without requiring a program restart.
guide_dev_db_desc:
Dapper micro-ORM is preferred over bulky frameworks like Entity Framework to avoid execution overhead and run raw SQL queries directly:
• Database Migrations: Incrementing `CurrentSchemaVersion` triggers automatic, data-loss-free database migrations. The engine reads SQLite user_version pragma and executes migrations (e.g. V14, V15) sequentially to adjust columns and indexes.
guide_dev_roadmap_desc:
1. User Roles & Security: Admin/Staff credentials and audit logs.
2. Cloud Sync: Real-time PostgreSQL/Firebase synchronization across multiple workstations.
3. Smart Notifications: Email or SMS alerts when items fall below critical thresholds.
